svg.text: Introduce a subject into a conversation for
I did not want to bring up the budget until
Separable: bring up a topic / bring a topic up /
bring it up. This lesson covers introducing a
subject; bring up can also mean raise a child.
A: Should we discuss the deadline now?
B: Yes, bring it up before the meeting ends.
A: Could I say, 'There is one deadline
concern I would like to bring up'?
